title: A hauler stranded in Crimson space or waiting at Nexus Prime, not yet paid Request for Records, joins Sol Central, where Request for Records (6,000 cr, Sol to Krynn and back) opens to it
note: Written by Apollo, 2026-11-24 01:51 UTC (orders ENT-084 block APOLLO: no hauler waits docked; P6: paying work where they stand, then standing corridors; rules F8, F34 tier 4, F35, F37). fill.py check 01:40 UTC: 64 haulers wait, 47 of them at Krynn War Citadel with the three Krynn once lines paid (fill.py status hauler). Request for Records (mission-request-for-records-confederacy, accept at Sol Central, redock at Krynn, hand in at Sol) paid 6,000 cr to every birth that flew it (table runs, 72 h: voidborn 19, outerrim 5 haulers; measured 18 runs, 54 min, 3,810 cr a run with the reward); 61 haulers in Krynn space or at Nexus Prime hold no such payment (table runs and ships, 01:52 UTC). The dispatcher holds the mission from them at 19 jumps (rule F34) without far_ok: this one-way trip (Krynn to Sol 19 jumps, the road of join-krynn-bloodforge; Nexus Prime to Sol 10 jumps, join-sol-hauler-nexus) places them at distance 0. skip_if_booked Request for Records: a paid pilot is never sent. in_system keeps the builders and receivers at Node Beta and the other stations home. In the list Then before join-krynn-bloodforge. Standing: a one-way trip judged by the mission it opens. At Sol the next leg is home (10 jumps) or the Solarian lines still unpaid.
